mkdir -p /etc/nginx/ssl /var/log/certrenew
cat > /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Renews the self-signed cert at /etc/nginx/ssl when it is within
# THRESHOLD seconds of expiry, then reloads nginx (graceful, no dropped conns).
set -eu

CERT=/etc/nginx/ssl/cert.pem
KEY=/etc/nginx/ssl/key.pem
THRESHOLD=120   # renew when less than 2 minutes of validity remain
VALIDITY_MINUTES=5

need_renew=1
if [ -f "$CERT" ]; then
    if openssl x509 -checkend "$THRESHOLD" -noout -in "$CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        need_renew=0
    fi
fi

if [ "$need_renew" -eq 0 ]; then
    exit 0
fi

TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
openssl req -x509 -nodes \
    -newkey rsa:2048 \
    -keyout "$TMPDIR/key.pem" \
    -out "$TMPDIR/cert.pem" \
    -days 0 \
    -not_before "$(date -u +%y%m%d%H%M%SZ)" \
    -not_after "$(date -u -d "+${VALIDITY_MINUTES} minutes" +%y%m%d%H%M%SZ 2>/dev/null || date -u -D '%s' -d "$(($(date +%s)+VALIDITY_MINUTES*60))" +%y%m%d%H%M%SZ)" \
    -subj "/CN=node1.cert-rotation.local" >/tmp/renew-openssl.log 2>&1

chmod 600 "$TMPDIR/key.pem"
mv "$TMPDIR/cert.pem" "$CERT.new"
mv "$TMPDIR/key.pem" "$KEY.new"
mv "$CERT.new" "$CERT"
mv "$KEY.new" "$KEY"
rmdir "$TMPDIR" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "$(date -Iseconds) renewed cert serial=$(openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -serial)" >> /var/log/certrenew/renew.log

if rc-service nginx status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nginx -t -c /etc/nginx/nginx.conf >/tmp/renew-nginx-test.log 2>&1 && rc-service nginx reload >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/renew-cert.sh
echo done
commands.stdout: done
